description: Labeled tasks for evaluating keyword-based explanation-format candidate selection. 'expected' is the format a reader would reasonably say the task asks for, independent of host capabilities. Labels are author judgments, not ground truth from users.

groups.explicit: The task explicitly asks for a format using a listed keyword.
groups.plain: Ordinary text tasks with no format vocabulary.
groups.topic: A format word appears as the subject matter, not as a requested output format.
groups.collision: Known substring/phrase collisions covered by the exclusion list or word boundaries.
groups.paraphrase: A format is requested without any listed keyword.
